# GitHub Copilot Instructions

> This repository uses a canonical single source of truth for AI instructions.

Please refer to and strictly follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root.

Key principles to respect at all times:
1. Maintain semantic-first documentation.
2. Never invent SLA, certifications, or performance metrics.
3. Keep GitHub Actions workflows hardened with minimum necessary permissions.
4. Preserve dark/light mode compatibility and text-only readability.
